segments.segment_summary: A man in a red flannel shirt explains his plan to cut telephone poles for a project, then uses a chainsaw to cut a pole and a tractor to move the pieces.

key_moments.caption: A close-up shot shows a man in a red flannel shirt and earmuffs explaining his plan for cutting the telephone poles.
The man uses a chainsaw to cut a section off the end of a long wooden telephone pole lying on the ground.
The man drives a red tractor with a grapple attachment, lifts the cut poles, and moves them towards a red pickup truck.
